{
  "name": "proposal-kit",
  "description": "A tiny design system for one solar proposal summary. Three components carry every amount a homeowner signs: Money, PaymentLine and SavingsEstimate. Made-up data; unofficial sample.",
  "rules": [
    "Build proposal views only from Money, PaymentLine, SavingsEstimate and the shadcn/ui primitives Card, Badge, Button and Separator.",
    "Never type a currency string such as \"$24,900\" and never format currency yourself (no Intl.NumberFormat with style currency, no toLocaleString currency, no \"$\" + value). Pass whole cents to Money.",
    "Never show a monthly payment except through PaymentLine. It requires apr and termMonths, so the APR and term always sit on the same line.",
    "Never show savings except through SavingsEstimate. It always says Estimated and always prints its assumptions (kWh a year, rate per kWh, yearly increase, years).",
    "Use token classes only (bg-card, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground, border, bg-primary, bg-success, bg-estimate and the others listed under tokens). No hex, rgb, px, inline style sizes or Tailwind palette classes such as bg-green-500; the palette is switched off.",
    "Status is never shown by color alone. Use a Badge with words, and an icon if you like.",
    "Do not mention tax credits, rebates or incentive amounts."
  ],
  "tokens": {
    "file": "src/styles/tokens.css",
    "themes": ["light (default)", "dark (add class \"dark\" to <html>)"],
    "colorClasses": {
      "surfaces": ["bg-background", "bg-card", "bg-muted", "bg-primary", "bg-secondary", "bg-success", "bg-estimate"],
      "text": ["text-foreground", "text-card-foreground", "text-muted-foreground", "text-primary", "text-primary-foreground", "text-secondary-foreground", "text-success-foreground", "text-estimate-foreground", "text-destructive"],
      "lines": ["border", "border-border", "ring-ring"]
    },
    "type": ["text-xs", "text-sm", "text-base", "text-lg", "text-xl", "text-2xl", "text-3xl"],
    "spacing": "Tailwind spacing classes (p-4, gap-2, mt-6 ...) are multiples of --pk-space-unit (0.25rem).",
    "radius": ["rounded-sm", "rounded-md", "rounded-lg", "rounded-full"],
    "contrast": "Every text token pair is at least 4.5:1 in light and dark (src/styles/tokens.test.ts)."
  },
  "components": [
    {
      "name": "Money",
      "path": "src/components/Money.tsx",
      "import": "import { Money } from \"@/components/Money\";",
      "purpose": "Shows any amount of money on a proposal: prices, line items, down payment, totals. The only place that formats currency.",
      "props": [
        { "name": "cents", "type": "number", "required": true, "description": "The amount in whole cents. 2490000 is $24,900. Never pass dollars. Throws on fractions of a cent." },
        { "name": "precision", "type": "\"auto\" | \"cents\" | \"dollars\"", "required": false, "default": "\"auto\"", "description": "auto hides .00 on whole-dollar amounts; cents always shows two decimals; dollars rounds to whole dollars." },
        { "name": "className", "type": "string", "required": false, "description": "Token classes only." }
      ],
      "do": [
        "Convert dollars to cents once, at the data layer: 24900 dollars is cents={2490000}.",
        "Use precision=\"dollars\" only for rounded estimates."
      ],
      "dont": [
        "Don't write \"$24,900\" or `$${price}` in JSX.",
        "Don't call Intl.NumberFormat or toLocaleString with style currency.",
        "Don't pass dollars: cents={24900} renders $249."
      ],
      "example": "<Money cents={2490000} />"
    },
    {
      "name": "PaymentLine",
      "path": "src/components/PaymentLine.tsx",
      "import": "import { PaymentLine } from \"@/components/PaymentLine\";",
      "purpose": "Shows a monthly loan payment with its APR and term on the same line, so a payment is never shown without the cost of the loan.",
      "props": [
        { "name": "monthlyCents", "type": "number", "required": true, "description": "The monthly payment in whole cents. 16028 is $160.28." },
        { "name": "apr", "type": "number", "required": true, "description": "Annual percentage rate as a percent: 5.99 means 5.99% APR." },
        { "name": "termMonths", "type": "number", "required": true, "description": "Loan term in months: 300 is 25 years." },
        { "name": "label", "type": "string", "required": false, "default": "\"Monthly payment\"", "description": "Heading above the amount." },
        { "name": "lender", "type": "string", "required": false, "description": "Lender or program name, printed under the terms." },
        { "name": "className", "type": "string", "required": false, "description": "Token classes only." }
      ],
      "do": [
        "Pass the real apr and termMonths from the loan offer.",
        "Use one PaymentLine per loan option."
      ],
      "dont": [
        "Don't write \"$160/mo\" or \"per month\" next to a Money.",
        "Don't make apr or termMonths optional or pass 0 to hide them."
      ],
      "example": "<PaymentLine monthlyCents={16028} apr={5.99} termMonths={300} lender=\"Made-up Credit Union solar loan\" />"
    },
    {
      "name": "SavingsEstimate",
      "path": "src/components/SavingsEstimate.tsx",
      "import": "import { SavingsEstimate } from \"@/components/SavingsEstimate\";",
      "purpose": "Shows estimated bill savings. Computes the figure from the assumptions, always labels it Estimated and always prints the assumptions under it.",
      "props": [
        { "name": "assumptions", "type": "{ annualKwh: number; ratePerKwhCents: number; yearlyIncreasePct: number; years: number }", "required": true, "description": "Yearly production in kWh, today's utility rate in cents per kWh (16 is $0.16), yearly rate increase as a percent (3 is 3%), and years covered." },
        { "name": "label", "type": "string", "required": false, "default": "\"Estimated bill savings over N years\"", "description": "Heading. If it does not start with Estimated, the component adds it." },
        { "name": "className", "type": "string", "required": false, "description": "Token classes only." }
      ],
      "do": [
        "Pass the same assumptions the proposal uses everywhere else.",
        "Let the component compute the figure; do not pass a savings number."
      ],
      "dont": [
        "Don't show a savings figure in your own markup.",
        "Don't hide or shorten the assumptions line.",
        "Don't add tax credits or incentives to savings."
      ],
      "example": "<SavingsEstimate assumptions={{ annualKwh: 13860, ratePerKwhCents: 16, yearlyIncreasePct: 3, years: 25 }} />"
    }
  ],
  "primitives": [
    { "name": "Card", "import": "import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from \"@/components/ui/card\";", "purpose": "Groups one topic: system, price, payment, savings." },
    { "name": "Badge", "import": "import { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\";", "purpose": "Status in words. Variants: default, secondary, success, estimate, outline." },
    { "name": "Button", "import": "import { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";", "purpose": "Actions. Variants: default, outline, secondary, ghost, link, destructive." },
    { "name": "Separator", "import": "import { Separator } from \"@/components/ui/separator\";", "purpose": "A line between groups, for example above a total." }
  ],
  "referenceView": "src/views/ProposalSummary.tsx",
  "checks": {
    "command": "npm run check",
    "runs": ["tsc -b (required props)", "eslint with proposal-kit rules", "scripts/check-tokens.mjs (hex/px in CSS)", "vitest (component tests, axe on the reference view, token contrast, lint rule tests)"],
    "lintRules": {
      "proposal-kit/no-raw-currency": "typed currency strings and hand-made currency formatting",
      "proposal-kit/payment-needs-terms": "monthly payment text without PaymentLine",
      "proposal-kit/tokens-only": "hex, rgb, px, inline px styles, arbitrary values and Tailwind palette classes",
      "proposal-kit/savings-needs-estimate": "savings text without SavingsEstimate",
      "proposal-kit/no-color-only-status": "a colored dot with no words"
    }
  }
}

content.text:
I've written the page to `src/views/GeneratedSummary.tsx`. I couldn't run `npm run check`, so it hasn't been type-checked, linted or rendered yet.

**I checked all your numbers and they agree:**
- **Price:** the three line items add up to $22,000. Minus the $2,000 down payment, that leaves $20,000 financed.
- **Loan:** $20,000 at 6.49% APR over 240 months works out to $149.00 a month, and 240 payments come to $35,760.
- **Savings:** 11,900 kWh at $0.15 is $1,785 the first year. Rising 3% a year for 25 years, that totals about $65,080.

**What's on the page:**
- **Header:** Brightline Home Solar, proposal P-2077, a "Ready to sign" badge, Maria Okafor's name and address, and the prepared date.
- **Your system:** 18 × 410 W panels, 7.38 kW, one microinverter per panel, and 11,900 kWh a year marked "Estimated".
- **Price:** the three line items, the total, the down payment and the amount financed.
- **Your loan:** the monthly payment shown with its APR and term on the same line, plus the total of 240 payments.
- **Savings:** the 25-year total and first-year figure, labelled "Estimated", with the assumptions printed underneath.

**How it's built:**
- It follows the project's design rules in `components.json`. All amounts are stored in cents and every dollar figure is formatted by the project's `Money` component, so no currency strings are typed by hand.
- The total price, amount financed and total of payments are calculated from the line items, so they can't drift from the inputs.
- The savings figures aren't typed in. The project's `SavingsEstimate` component calculates them from the rate and production, and the result matches your $65,080 and $1,785.

**Things to know:**
- **I left out a "Sign" button** because there's no signing step to connect it to. Tell me what it should do and I'll add it.
- **One lint rule might flag the "Total of 240 payments" row.** The project has a rule against showing payment text without the APR and term. That row sits right under the monthly payment, but the rule may not see it that way. If it complains, I can move that figure onto the monthly payment line.
